source: Authorized no-op multipart write/read round trip on /dev/hidraw10
notes: Corrected against ObinsKit's DWARF-backed downloadKbdLayout call: multi_package_create receives the 61 keycodes and one-byte layer prefix as separate vectors. USB limit 0x35 minus prefix length gives 52 keycodes per packet, and the layer prefix is repeated in both packets: layer+52, then layer+9.
